Name: Sapiens Wind Effects
Author: SapiensTraaveler
Description:
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53032/53032-1790535987-1930608478.gif[/img]


[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53032/53032-1790535979-1202979438.gif[/img]

If the mod gives you any errors or you run into any problems, please let me know in the comments. And remember, this is the first version, so it’s not perfect. I’ll keep improving it over time.


[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53032/53032-1790536235-1529295394.png[/img]

I’m not sure if this will be very useful, but I also added some options in case you’d like to change the size of the breeze effect in-game or make it smaller. 


[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53032/53032-1790536374-418725814.png[/img]
And as an extra requirement, this is essential for the mod to work: you must follow me on Twitter. I haven’t posted anything yet, but little by little, I’ll start uploading some stuff.

Downloads.Description: Maybe sometime in the future I’ll make an Android version, but I’m not sure yet.
